description: Ground-truth reference data mined directly from the engine's own example save file (jCRPG-engine/save/game1_20100426-004720.124/savegame.zip -> gamestate.xml, an XStream-serialized org.jcrpg.game.GameStateContainer). This is a real, fully generated instance of the default 'JClassicRPG' scenario at seed 0 — not a guess at the schema. It was captured a few turns into play (numberOfTurn=9), so party/engine fields reflect that mid-game moment, but the world geography/settlements/roads were fixed at New Game time and are authentic.
howExtracted: unzip savegame.zip -> gamestate.xml (26MB XStream XML), then regex-extracted specific elements (this file is far too large to port/parse in full; treat it as a mineable source, not something to copy wholesale).

scenario.name: JClassicRPG
scenario.descText: Default Scenario. Wandering around, discovering the world of jClassicRPG.
scenario.author: Pal Zoltan Illes

world.impliedWorldParams: magnification=40 with realSize 1600x80x1600 implies WorldParams sizeX=40, sizeY=2, sizeZ=40 (realSize = size * magnification)

engineAtCapture.note: Not the New Game starting time (that is hour=12, turn=0 per SaveLoadNewGame); this is a few turns later.

playerPositionAtCapture.note: Position after some turns of play, not the New Game spawn point.

roadShrines.description: RoadShrines mark road-network waypoints/shrines the new-game spawn snaps to the nearest of. Coordinates are [origoX, origoY, origoZ].

settlementsDistricts.description: Populated settlement districts placed by EcologyGenerator/EconomyContainer; id encodes the population/ecology group and an instance number.

characterBaseAttributes.description: Confirmed real default base attribute set for a new party (all start at 10).

characterBaseResistances.description: Confirmed real default base resistance set (partial list observed; all start at 10).

recommendation.runningOriginalEngine: Still not attempted: no JRE or Maven is installed in this environment, and the project targets Java 1.5 with 15-year-old ardor3d/lwjgl/jinput native binaries (x86, not arm64/Apple Silicon compatible). UPDATE: the scenario data files (worldparams.xml/ecology.xml) previously believed missing were actually found at media/ai/world/default_worldparams.xml and media/ai/ecology/default_ecology.xml (see worlds.json realDefaultWorldParams/realDefaultEcology) — so the remaining blocker to running the original engine is purely toolchain/native-library availability, not missing data.
recommendation.cachingFinding: cache/{low,medium,high,low_png} only ever store converted 3D model geometry (see world_assets.json/rendering_assets.json) — there is no cached *generated world* data there. The only real generated-world snapshot in this repo is this save file (gamestate.xml inside save/game1_20100426-004720.124/savegame.zip), which is why it was mined here instead.
suggestedNextSteps: Treat this file's numbers as authentic reference/validation data for a from-scratch JS world generator, not something to load verbatim (the full XML is 26MB of XStream-specific serialization and not worth parsing in the browser).

Now that media/ (real .obj models, textures, UI art, portraits, shaders, and the real worldparams/ecology XML) has been located, prioritize wiring real assets into play.html/render_engine.js over building placeholder art.

Port world generation conceptually (WorldParams-driven terrain/road/settlement placement) rather than transliterating the Java 1:1, using this file's real magnification/size/shrine-count/district-count and the now-confirmed real worldparams.xml/ecology.xml as the source of truth for the JS port's output.
